title: A content-lane worker runs the test selection the sync gate runs, not the whole suite, so parallel workers do not push each other over the ceiling
goal: The brief of a worker whose item touches only kb content tells it to run python3 _tools/tests.py --changed origin/main (the selection kbgit.py sync runs for that change) instead of the whole suite. In SP-lsamtvsz four parallel content workers each ran the whole suite: ST-4u4grn6b 32 s then 30 s, ST-b4swnror 40 s, ST-rcdjzn5k 31 s, BG-dwxlx7nv 29 s, ST-aob7dslq 31 s against the 29 s darwin ceiling; every landing's gate then ran only the content selection.
notes: SP-lsamtvsz retrospective finding (2026-10-14), parked as a draft by the orchestrating session acting for the operator. Recurred in SP-g2ssvhi2 (host load, items run one at a time): worker whole-suite runs were refused over the darwin ceiling at 31 s (BG-chw4sg54), 30 s (TK-zqeq54ma), 32 s (TK-iyfruywl) and 31 s three times (ST-5z4e6z4i, which then reported tests.py exit 1); each landing's sync-gate whole suite and the review's done run passed.
